projection: x=96+cos(yaw)*lateral+sin(yaw)*forward; y=worldY+0.18*depth; depth=cos(yaw)*forward-sin(yaw)*lateral. Positive depth is nearer.

extra_joints.sword_tip: end of the blade (hand_right + 54px along the blade)

slash.label: 通常斬り（振り下ろし）
phases: 構え guard
予備動作 anticipation: sink, turn the sword side back
振りかぶり raise: blade over the head, shield arm reaches forward
溜め top of the raise: back arched, sword foot leaves the ground
踏み込み step lands: hips whip round first, blade still up
振り下ろし the cut: shoulders follow the hips, arm snaps down
命中 impact (hit-stop): knees give, weight on the front foot
振り抜き follow-through: blade carried low across the body
残心 hold: stays down for a breath
戻り recover: rise, blade back up
引き step back: the front foot comes back
構え guard again
